svg.title: Nena Sign-to-Swahili Architecture
svg.desc: Five-stage pipeline: video capture, CLIP encoder, few-shot classifier, Swahili token, voice router, TTS output
svg.text: Tanzanian / Kenyan Sign Language → Swahili Speech

g.text: • + 8 more signs (expand with real TSL frames)
5–10 frames per sign is enough to start · use ffmpeg to extract at 5 fps

svg.text: Swahili is gender-neutral → voice gender set by user profile, not by parsed text
